question: What ritual substance and doctrinal principle must not be disparaged by the practitioner?
premises: The sacred offering (caru) must not be reviled.
The non-duality of the vow must not be reviled.
The instruction is addressed to the fair one.
inference: One must not disparage the sacred offering nor the non-dual principle of the vow.
plain_english: O fair one, one should not revile the sacred offering, nor indeed the non-duality of the vow.
